WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.TITLE: Templates
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: Create, change and submit the WhatsApp message templates your inboxes use. WhatsApp reviews every template before it can be sent.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.SYNC_SUCCESS: Template sync started for all WhatsApp inboxes. Updates may take a couple of minutes.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.PARTIAL_SYNC_ERROR: Template sync started for some WhatsApp inboxes, but others could not be synced.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.SYNC_ERROR: Unable to start template sync. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.FETCH_ERROR: Unable to load WhatsApp templates. Please try again.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.PARTIAL_FETCH_ERROR: Some WhatsApp templates could not be loaded. Please try again.

STATUSES.SUBMISSION_FAILED: WhatsApp did not accept the submission

PREVIEW.TITLE: Template preview
PREVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Preview how this template appears in WhatsApp.

WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.EMPTY_NO_INBOX: Connect a WhatsApp inbox to manage templates.
WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_MGMT.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Templates are the messages WhatsApp lets you start a conversation with. Create one here and submit it for review.

SUBMIT.TITLE: Submit this template to WhatsApp?
SUBMIT.DESCRIPTION: WhatsApp reviews it before it can be sent, which usually takes minutes but can take longer. Its name and language cannot be changed afterwards.

EDIT_APPROVED.TITLE: This template goes back into review
EDIT_APPROVED.DESCRIPTION: Saving a change sends the template to WhatsApp for review again, so it may be unavailable for a while. WhatsApp allows one change every 24 hours and ten every 30 days for an approved template.

DELETE.TITLE: Delete {name}?
DELETE.DESCRIPTION_DRAFT: This draft has never been sent to WhatsApp, so it is only deleted here.
DELETE.DESCRIPTION_REMOTE: The template is deleted at WhatsApp as well, campaigns and flows using it stop working, and WhatsApp blocks the name for 30 days.

DETAIL.SUBMISSION_ERROR: Why the submission did not go through
DETAIL.MISSING_NOTICE: This template is no longer in your WhatsApp account. It was last seen on {date}. Duplicate it to start a new draft.
DETAIL.DRAFT_NOTICE: WhatsApp has never seen this template. Submit it for review when it is ready.
DETAIL.CSAT_NOTICE: This is the survey template for an inbox. Manage it in that inbox’s CSAT settings.

NAME.LABEL: Name
NAME.HELP: Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores. WhatsApp does not allow the name to change later.

LANGUAGE.LABEL: Language
LANGUAGE.HELP: The language of this template’s text, not of the dashboard. It cannot change later.

INBOX.LABEL: WhatsApp inbox
INBOX.HELP: The template is created in this inbox’s WhatsApp account, and every inbox sharing that account can send it.

CATEGORY.LABEL: Category
CATEGORY.HELP: WhatsApp decides the final category and may change it.

HEADER.LABEL: Header
HEADER.TEXT_PLACEHOLDER: Your order is on its way
HEADER.HANDLE_HELP: WhatsApp needs a sample for review. Upload the file in WhatsApp Manager once and paste the handle it gives you.

BODY.LABEL: Message
BODY.HELP: Up to 1024 characters. A variable cannot start or end the message, and two cannot sit together.

FOOTER.LABEL: Footer
FOOTER.HELP: Up to 60 characters, and no variables.

BUTTONS.LABEL: Buttons
BUTTONS.HELP: Up to ten buttons. Keep quick replies together: WhatsApp refuses them mixed in among the others.

EXAMPLES.TITLE: Sample values
EXAMPLES.HELP: WhatsApp reviews the template with these, and they are never sent to a customer.

PROBLEMS.TITLE: Fix these before submitting
PROBLEMS.NO_GUARANTEE: These are the rules WhatsApp publishes. Passing them does not mean WhatsApp will approve the template.

STARTERS.TITLE: Start from a common one
STARTERS.HELP: These fill the form with a draft to edit. They are not WhatsApp templates and nothing here is approved: WhatsApp reviews whatever you submit.

PROBLEM.name_format: The name may only use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
PROBLEM.component_unsupported: This template has a part {installationName} cannot edit. Manage it in WhatsApp Manager.
PROBLEM.component_duplicated: There is more than one of this part.
PROBLEM.body_too_long: The message is longer than {limit} characters.
PROBLEM.header_too_long: The header is longer than {limit} characters.
PROBLEM.header_too_many_variables: A header may hold one variable.
PROBLEM.header_format_unsupported: This header type cannot be edited here.
PROBLEM.header_example_missing: Add a sample media handle for the header.
PROBLEM.footer_too_long: The footer is longer than {limit} characters.
PROBLEM.buttons_too_many: There can be at most {limit} buttons.
PROBLEM.button_type_unsupported: This button type cannot be edited here.
PROBLEM.button_type_too_many: There can be at most {limit} of this button type.
PROBLEM.buttons_quick_reply_not_grouped: Keep the quick replies next to each other.
PROBLEM.button_text_too_long: The label is longer than {limit} characters.
PROBLEM.button_url_too_long: The address is longer than {limit} characters.
PROBLEM.button_url_too_many_variables: A website button may hold one variable.
PROBLEM.button_url_variable_not_at_end: The variable has to come at the end of the address.
PROBLEM.button_phone_too_long: The phone number is longer than {limit} characters.
PROBLEM.button_copy_code_too_long: The sample code is longer than {limit} characters.
PROBLEM.button_example_missing: Add a sample value for this button.
PROBLEM.variable_at_edge: A variable cannot be the first or last thing in the text.
PROBLEM.variables_adjacent: Put some text between two variables.
PROBLEM.variables_not_sequential: Number the variables 1, 2, 3 in the order they appear.
PROBLEM.variable_name_invalid: A variable name may only use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
PROBLEM.variable_duplicated: Each variable name can be used once.
PROBLEM.variable_example_missing: Add a sample value for every variable.

ERRORS.SUBMIT_IN_FLIGHT: This template is already being submitted.
ERRORS.NOT_EDITABLE: WhatsApp only allows a template to change while it is approved, rejected or paused.
ERRORS.CATEGORY_NOT_EDITABLE: WhatsApp does not allow the category of an approved template to change.
ERRORS.NOT_DELETABLE: WhatsApp does not allow a disabled template to be deleted.
ERRORS.CSAT_MANAGED_ELSEWHERE: This survey template is managed in the inbox’s CSAT settings.
ERRORS.NO_WHATSAPP_INBOX: The WhatsApp inbox this template belongs to is no longer connected.
ERRORS.INVALID_TEMPLATE: Fix the highlighted problems and try again.
ERRORS.NAME_TAKEN: This account already has a template with that name in that language.
ERRORS.AUTH_INVALID: WhatsApp refused the credentials for this inbox. Reconnect it and try again.
ERRORS.RATE_LIMITED: WhatsApp is rate limiting this account. Try again shortly.
ERRORS.META_UNAVAILABLE: WhatsApp could not be reached. Try again shortly.
ERRORS.GENERIC: Something went wrong. Please try again.
